answer: Treat reputation as a conserved, non-transferable mass: each verified root is granted one fixed block that it can never forge more of. Splitting it across many agents only slices that single block of ivory into thinner shards, so a swarm total influence stays flat instead of multiplying. View any suspected cluster through the prism of its shared funding and enrollment origin, and the illusion of many independent voices collapses back into one capped voice.
